CREATE TABLE "headlines" ("id" varchar NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "text" varchar NOT NULL, "writer" varchar NOT NULL, "server_version" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "sync_state" varchar DEFAULT 'synced' NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "instant_record_applied_mutations" ("id" integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, "mutation_id" varchar NOT NULL, "result_payload" text, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "instant_record_changes" ("id" integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, "record_type" varchar NOT NULL, "record_id" varchar NOT NULL, "operation" varchar NOT NULL, "version" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "attributes_payload" text, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "scope" varchar)

CREATE TABLE "instant_record_outbox" ("id" varchar NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "record_type" varchar NOT NULL, "record_id" varchar NOT NULL, "operation" varchar NOT NULL, "changes_payload" text, "base_version" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "instant_record_sync_metadata" ("key" varchar NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" varchar, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "issues" ("id" varchar NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "title" varchar NOT NULL, "state" varchar DEFAULT 'open' NOT NULL, "server_version" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "sync_state" varchar DEFAULT 'synced' NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "mail_entries" ("id" varchar NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "mailbox_id" varchar NOT NULL, "author" varchar NOT NULL, "kind" varchar NOT NULL, "parent_id" varchar, "address" varchar, "subject" varchar, "body" text, "server_version" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "sync_state" varchar DEFAULT 'synced' NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE "mailboxes" ("id" varchar NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "revision" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "messages" ("id" varchar NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "channel_id" varchar NOT NULL, "chat_user_id" varchar NOT NULL, "body" text NOT NULL, "server_version" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "sync_state" varchar DEFAULT 'synced' NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "parent_message_id" varchar)

CREATE TABLE "notes" ("id" varchar NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "title" varchar NOT NULL, "body" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, "server_version" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "sync_state" varchar DEFAULT 'synced' NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL)
